For older data, Bitget provides web-based download centers where you can export the full history — in most cases as far back as January 1, 2018 . This page maps each API endpoint to the download entry point that covers its older data. Download Center Covers Jump to 📊 Market Data Candlestick / Trades / Depth ↓ Section 📦 Personal Account Data Classic spot/futures/margin, earn orders, UTA orders ↓ Section 📊 Market Data Download Center ​ Download entry point bitget.com/data-download — historical candlestick, trades, and depth data. 💰 Spot ​ Data Type Description 🕯️ Candlestick OHLC and volume candlestick data for each trading pair, including historical data beyond the API's default query range 🔄 Trades Public fills on the platform, including historical fills beyond the API's 90-day query window 📉 Depth A snapshot of bid/ask order book depth, including merged depth by price precision 📈 Futures ​ Data Type Description 🕯️ Candlestick OHLC and volume candlestick data for each contract (including index/mark price variants), including historical data beyond the API's default query range 🔄 Trades Public fills on the platform, including historical fills beyond the API's 90-day query window 📉 Depth A bid/ask depth snapshot with price levels merged by precision 📦 Personal Account Data ​ API endpoints are limited to a recent query window (typically 90 days). If you need older personal order, fill, or financial data, the web Export Center offers broader download coverage, organized by account type and business category. Download entry point bitget.com/asset/export/downOrders 💰 Classic Spot ​ Data Type Description 📋 Order History All spot orders placed on the account, including filled, partially filled, and cancelled orders 🔄 Fill History Execution details of spot orders, including price, quantity, and fees 💵 Financial Records Spot account balance changes, such as trade debits/credits, transfers, and promotional rewards 🏦 Deposit/Withdrawal Records Crypto deposit and withdrawal records on the spot account 📈 Classic Futures ​ Data Type Description 📋 Order History Futures orders, including limit and market orders 📊 Positions History Closed historical positions, including open/close price, PnL, and leverage 🔄 Fill History Execution details of futures orders 💵 Financial Records Futures account balance changes, such as funding fees, realized PnL, and transfers ⚖️ Classic Margin ​ Data Type Description 📋 Order History Orders placed on cross or isolated margin accounts 💵 Financial Records Margin account balance changes, including borrowing, repayment, and interest 💎 Earn Orders ​ Data Type Description 🪙 Savings Subscription, redemption, and interest payout records for flexible/fixed savings products ⛓️ On-chain Earn Orders for on-chain earn products such as staking and liquidity mining 🔀 Dual Investment Subscription and settlement records for Dual Investment products 🦈 Shark Fin Subscription and settlement records for Shark Fin structured products 🏦 UTA ​ Data Type Description 📋 Order History Order records across spot, futures, margin, and other business lines under a Unified Trading Account 📊 Positions History Closed historical positions under a Unified Trading Account 💵 Financial Records Balance change records for a Unified Trading Account 🔀 Coin Conversion Records History of in-account coin-to-coin conversions Data range Unless otherwise noted on the page, data is available as early as January 1, 2018 . current_metadata.fields: symbol, category, baseCoin, quoteCoin, type, status, launchTime, offTime, limitOpenTime, maintainTime, instrumentType, marketRegion, fullName, isin (where applicable)
limitations: V3 explicitly enumerates online instruments, not every instrument that existed during the window.
BTCUSDT launchTime=0 is not a usable listing date. AAPL V2/V3 launch/open fields differ.
offTime describes halt time, not a complete historical delisting/maintenance interval ledger.
Ticker, issuer name, region and ISIN are not a stable historical derivative-contract identity or rename/relisting chain.
First/last actual executable trading timestamps and historical halt/resumption intervals are not established.

documented_parameters.annType: coin_listings, symbol_delisting, maintenance_system_updates and other categories
documented_parameters.startTime: Unix milliseconds; announcement display time, NOT trading effective time

dated_notice_index.observed: Each of three first-page category requests for the exact saved window returned HTTP 400, API code 70010, The query time range is not within the last 30 days. No dated notice rows were recovered.
limits: This demonstrates rejection of these exact requests, not a proof of global 30-day retention or absence of older notices. No shorter-window retry or pagination was attempted after the blocker.
The reviewed documentation does not guarantee all lifecycle events are published, historical corrections remain enumerable, translations agree, or every removed symbol remains indexed.

Even successful display-time pagination would not establish completeness: announcements before September 17 can have effective events within the window; opening membership and effective times are required.

official_export_catalog.observed: Official download-center documentation lists historical futures candles, public fills and depth. Its broad history wording concerns listed data types, not a listing/delisting/halt/identity manifest.
official_export_catalog.limits: No complete dated contract-membership export or full lifecycle ledger is documented in the reviewed catalog; this does not prove Bitget has no such export elsewhere. No personal account export was accessed.

requirements.requirement: Authoritative complete inventory at 2026-09-17T00:00:00Z including contracts later removed, plus provenance of opening tradability states.

All listing, delisting, halt, resumption, restriction, rename, migration and relisting events effective before 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z; include notices published outside the target interval if effective inside it.

Official completeness statement and versioned export totals/checksums or documented finite cursor termination with authoritative category/language/retention coverage and missing-event reconciliation; pagination alone is insufficient.
Stable venue contract IDs, base-asset IDs, aliases with validity intervals, product/settlement/quote classification and separate contract generations for reused tickers.

UTC effective listing/delisting/halts/resumptions and restrictions distinct from publication/display times; explicit first/last trading timestamps and inclusive/exclusive semantics, unknowns preserved.

Reconcile opening inventory plus events to official closing inventory; identify duplicate/missing/revised notices and validate selected identities and trade boundaries against existing first-party evidence without using gaps as lifecycle proof.

rules: Null means unverified, never zero or epoch substituted as a listing date.
Permanent contract identity is not inferred solely from ticker/ISIN.
Maintain publication-time availability separately from effective membership for point-in-time selection.
Opening interval may begin before saved window; closing membership is evaluated at the end-exclusive boundary.
No eligible symbols or performance results are generated until every completeness gate passes.

delivery.precise_blocker: Current online instruments omit historical membership guarantees. The documented dated announcements route rejects the full saved interval in all three relevant categories with 70010; the inspected export catalog lists market/account data, not a complete lifecycle manifest. Neither an authoritative opening inventory nor a complete event/identity ledger was obtained. Parent #10 remains blocked for survivorship-corrected broad-universe results.
delivery.next_official_data_request: Request from Bitget official API support/data-download support a versioned public export or supported read-only historical index for all USDT-margined perpetual contracts active at any time in [2026-09-17T00:00:00Z,2026-11-01T00:00:00Z), including instruments subsequently removed, an authoritative opening inventory, all effective listing/delisting/halt/resumption/restriction/rename/relisting events, stable contract/base-asset IDs and ticker validity, crypto versus RWA/stock classification, UTC first/last trade boundaries and revisions with publication/known-at timestamps. Ask for explicit completeness/retention/category/language guarantees, export totals/checksums and closing-inventory reconciliation, plus exact anonymous GET URL/parameters and pagination/termination contract that can access dates older than the observed 70010 rejection. Notices published before the window but effective inside it must be included. Do not supply credentials or place orders.
not_claimed: No proof that official historical data does not exist.
No complete universe, survivorship correction, empirical broad-universe run, complete trades, historical executable-price coverage or trading conclusions.

budget.accounting: Live budget counts fresh first-party source transactions only. GitHub issue reads/posts are administrative calls, not Bitget source HTTP transactions. Prior response bodies were not downloaded again. Byte counts are response bodies delivered by curl, not TLS/HTTP headers; no compression requested.

validation.checks: JSON parse/roundtrip; every fresh base64 body length and SHA256; exact query timestamps; status/code rejection; official-host restriction; no redirects/retries; all request wall times <=15s; completeness and survivor claims false; all gate requirements unpassed; prior artifact hashes recomputed.
